title: Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) - Digital Database and Corresponding Interfaces for ReUse of Architectural Components (v0.6.4.6)
description:
The Catalog of Second Chances (CSC) is a prototypical digital component database. It catalogs digital representations of uniquely identifiable architectural components for reuse. Furthermore, it provides corresponding interfaces and tools to leverage them via a backend REST-API, a web-frontend as well as a interface for direct interaction within Rhino Grasshopper.

Changes in v0.6.4.6 (2026-11-25)

Hardening of the image uploads, and pinned backend packages. No Grasshopper change: CSC_Update is not needed for this release.

Security

  • Image uploads (photos and evidence attachments): an image is checked in its raw bytes before it is opened. Refused are, besides images above 40 megapixels: a WebP above 16 megapixels, more than 256 KB of EXIF metadata, EXIF or multi-picture directories with too many or too large entries, and a JPEG with more than 64 scans. The refusal names the reason.
  • Web packages: Next.js 16.4.5 (seven advisories of medium severity), and hono, @hono/node-server and body-parser, which only development tools use. With this Next.js version a download through the web app shows no size beforehand.

Changed

  • Photo metadata: a stored photo keeps camera make, model and capture time only as text of at most 64 characters and the orientation only when it is valid. The JPEG comment (and a PNG text comment) is dropped, also from the picture in the PDF passport. scripts/db_maintenance/migrate_strip_photo_gps.py removes the comment from photos stored earlier.
  • Server packages: constraints.txt pins every package of the backend exactly, each at a version at least two weeks old. The server builds a new environment with this release.

Fixed

  • An image that cannot be converted is refused (400 for a photo, 415 for an attachment) instead of ending in a 500.

Full history: CHANGELOG.md
